parameters.content:
## WordPress → Email: Daily HTML Digest

Emails a **mobile-friendly HTML digest** of your WordPress posts from the last 24 hours — native REST API, **no plugin needed**.

- 🛡️ **No duplicates** — only posts from the last `daysBack` window
- 🖼️ **Rich HTML** — featured image, excerpt, date, Read more button
- 📧 **Smart skip** — no email when nothing was published
- 🔧 **Reusable** — point `siteUrl` at any WordPress site

### Setup
1. Open **Set Email and Post Limits** → set `siteUrl`, `toEmail`
2. Add SMTP credentials to **Send Digest Email**
3. Activate — the first digest arrives next morning at 8:00

## Schedule & Config

Runs daily at 8:00 and holds the site URL, look-back window, post limit and recipient email.

## Fetch & Build

Pulls the latest posts from the WordPress REST API and composes the HTML digest.

## Check & Send

Skips when nothing is new; otherwise sends the digest via SMTP.
